blocks.text: אֶשָּׂא דֵעִי בְּצֶדֶק. תֵּת לְפוֹעֲלִי צֶדֶק. אֶשְׁאֲלָה מִשְׁפְּטֵי צֶדֶק. קוֹל לְהָרִים כַּשּׁוֹפָר: אֵין קוֹרֵא בְצֶדֶק. רוֹדֵף צֶדֶק צֶדֶק. אֶקְרָא שִׁמְעָה צֶדֶק. בְּקוֹל בָּלוּל כַּשּׁוֹפָר: בַּנְתִּי בְמַדָּעִי. לְמֵרָחוֹק שְׂאֵת דֵעִי. בִּטּוּי תְּרוּעָה בְּיָדְעִי. בְּקוֹל מַתַּן שׁוֹפָר: בּוֹ בְהָרִיעִי. אֲרַצֶּה לִי רוֹעִי. בְּאָמְצוֹ זְרוֹעִי. בְּקוֹל כֹּחַ שׁוֹפָר: גַּשְׁתִּי בְּיוֹם דִּין. לְהִתְוַכֵּחַ בַּדִּין. גּוֹלֶה עֹמֶק הַדִּין. בְּקוֹל קִפָּאוֹן שֹׁפָר: גְּזֵרַת דַּת וָדִין. אִם חִיַּבְתִּי בַּדִּין. גְּרוֹנִי יְעַכֵּב מוֹרַע דִּין. בְּקוֹל עִם שׁוֹפָר: דְּרֹשׁ וְהַעַל רְטִיָּה. לִפְנֵי טְרִיָּה. דַּעַת לִטְרוּיָה. קוֹל חֲבֵשׁ שׁוֹפָר: דָּחוּי לִכְרוּיָה. בְּעַד נִבְרִיָּה.

Lines 02, 05 and 16 have a small tick after the line-final letter (אֶשְׁאֲלָה, תְּרוּעָה, שֶׂה). I treat it as a line-end flourish and do not encode it.

blocks.text: אָנוּסָה לְעֶזְרָה. אֶמְצָא נֶגְדִּי. אֵל קָרוֹב לִי. בְּעֵת קָרְאִי בְּקוֹל: אֲשֶׁר בַּעֲדַת אֵל. בְּקִרְבִּי נִצָּב. וּפֹה בְּמִקְדָּשׁ מְעַט. אֲצַפְצֵף לוֹ בְּקוֹל: בַּקְּרֵנִי דָּרְשֵׁנִי. שֶׂה פְזוּרָה אָנִי. נִגְזַרְתִּי וְנֶאֱלַמְתִּי. בְּלִי לְהָרִים קוֹל: בֶּאֱמוֹר גּוֹזְזַי. נִדָּחָה הִיא. שׁוֹמְרָהּ וְצִלָּהּ. לֹא יִשְׁאַג בְּקוֹל: גַּלְתִּי שִׂיחַ בְּחֻקָּיו. וְחִכִּי עָרֵב. הִטָּה אֹזֶן וְשָׂח. הַשְׁמִיעִנִי אֶת קוֹלֵךְ קוֹל: גָּז וּבָרַח מֶנִּי. כְּעֹפֶר עַל הָרֵי בָתֶר. בְּבַקְּשׁוֹ דָת וָאוֹת. בְּמִשְׁכְּנוֹתַי וְאֵין קוֹל: דִּלֵּג מִבֶּתֶר לְבֶתֶר. הֲשִׁיבֵהוּ אֵלַי. אוּלַי יִשָּׂא פָנֶיךָ. עֵקֶב שָׁמְעֵךְ בְּקוֹל: דְּרוֹשׁ טוֹבָה לָמוֹ. וּרְאֵה שֵׂה מוֹרִיָּה. אִלֵּם פִּיהוּ יְהִי צֶדֶק. לְלֹא שָׁמְעָה בְּקוֹל: הָסֵר מֵחָלָק. יָדַיִם
uncertainties: Aleph-lamed ligatures are printed in אֵל (line15, end of strophe), לֹא (line18) and לְלֹא (line24). They are encoded as separate letters plus their vowels. The אֵל on line14 is printed as separate letters.

blocks.text: I meditate on righteousness to ascribe righteousness to my Creator; I ask for judgments of righteousness and raise my voice like a Shofar. When none proclaims in righteousness and none pursues righteousness, I call out for a hearing in righteousness in a voice mingled with the Shofar. I understood through my knowledge when I raised my mind far distant and know that the utterance of Teruah sounded at the Revelation through the Shofar. By blowing Teruah I appease my shepherd, who strengthens my arm through the powerful sound of the Shofar. I approached on the day of justice to plead for myself with justice; He reveals the depths of justice through the curdling sound of the Shofar. If I am guilty in justice according to the decree of law and justice, may my throat restrain the severity of justice through my voice together with the Shofar. Seek out and bring healing for the wound, let the mind of the wounded people be soothed by the sound of the Shofar. Let freedom for the banished, who are sold to a strange people, and for every human

blocks.text: I hasten for aid and find God near me at the time when I call with my voice. In the congregation of God, He stands in my midst and here in this miniature sanctuary I mutter to Him with my voice. Test me, examine me, a stray sheep am I, I have been cast off and silenced so that I cannot raise my voice. When my shearers say ‘she is rejected’, her guardian and protector does not roar with His voice. When I conversed of His statutes and my sound was pleasing, He inclined His ear and spoke; ‘Let me hear the sound of your voice’. Swiftly He fled from me like the deer on the rocky mountains, when He desired law and a sign from me and in my dwellings there was no voice. He who leapt from fragment to fragment (Abraham), let him restore Him to me, perhaps He will raise your face because you heard His voice.
